headline: Pros and Cons of Heat Pumps
subheading: Heat pumps are several times more efficient than a furnace, and they heat and cool in one unit. They also cost more to install and need to be sized right. Here are 9 pros and 9 cons for heating and cooling your home.
seoTitle: Heat Pump Pros and Cons: 9 Benefits and 9 Drawbacks
description: Thinking about a heat pump for your home? The 9 biggest pros and 9 biggest cons of air source heat pumps: efficiency, cost, cold weather, noise and more.
